verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a locally run, cross-platform tool and set of libraries whose source is published on GitHub ([ffmpeg-gh-1..6], [ffmpeg-docs-2]). Community reports show users running it on their own machines and servers, including custom-compiled builds, local AI pipelines with Whisper and Real-ESRGAN, and no commercial paywall ([ffmpeg-comm-3], [ffmpeg-comm-6], [ffmpeg-comm-7], [ffmpeg-comm-15]). Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement and build/installation documentation in the evidence pack.
